title: FlowFactoryProbes
description: The factory's probe record: what each go/no-go probe found, against which tool versions, and what was spent. Written by flow-factory.sh probe; read before any factory launch.

interpreter.description: The realpath of the Python interpreter the wrapper runs, recorded by the environment group. A copy made by probe --export writes the user's home as ~.

groups.description: Each probe group, with the values its results were keyed on and when it ran. A group whose keyed values change is out of date.

cap_usd.description: The total model spend the probes may reach. A run is started only when spent_usd plus its budget limit fits under the cap, but a budget limit is not an upper bound (a one-turn run has reported $0.148 against a $0.10 limit), so spent_usd can pass the cap by what the last run spent past its limit.

spent_usd.description: What the probe runs were charged: for each run, what it spent since the session's last result (the costUSD of each model in its result's model_usage_since_last_result), else its total_cost_usd; its budget limit when it ended without a result (killed, timed out, stopped by a signal); nothing when claude never started.

keyed_on.description: Tool versions and other values the results depend on, for example claude_version, gh_version, git_version, interpreter, permission_mode, sandbox.

deferred_to.description: The phase issue that now carries the go condition this probe could not check, as owner/repo#N.

parts.description: The probe's separate checks, each with its own result. The probe's result is computed from them: no-go when any part is no-go, else not_run when any part did not run, else deferred when any part is deferred, else go.

stand_in.description: True when the probe ran against a stand-in for a factory part that does not exist yet. Such a probe is never go.

evidence_history.description: The earlier evidence folders this entry still draws on: a later run that keeps parts or writes an earlier run recorded points evidence at its own folder and lists the earlier ones here. The export copies them all.

keyed_on.description: The values this probe's result was recorded under, as its group's keyed_on read then, without the launch_context keys unless the probe is P13. A probe whose keyed_on differs from its group's on a key both hold (permission_modes, and launch_context keys for every probe but P13, left out) is stale: the group ran again without it. An entry without it, in a group that has keyed_on, is unstamped and fails the record check, unless it never ran (not_run, cost 0, no evidence).

ran_at.description: When this probe's entry was recorded.

github_writes.description: Every GitHub write the probe's runs attempted through the gh and git shim, from its call log: the calls that found gh or git on PATH, not a program run by its full path or git running another git itself. A gh command the shim does not know to be a read counts as a write, and a write whose repository cannot be told is listed as unresolved/unresolved. A write the shim or the gh stand-in refused never reached GitHub and is marked refused; --verify-record --writes-only-to lists it on a PROBES_REFUSED_WRITE= line and does not fail on it.

keyed_on.description: The values this part was recorded under. A part kept from an earlier run keeps the keyed_on it was recorded under, so one entry's parts can hold different tool versions. A part whose keyed_on differs from its probe's group's on a key both hold is stale, compared as the entry's keyed_on is. A part without it, in a group that has keyed_on, is unstamped and fails the record check, unless its entry never ran.

evidence.description: The evidence folder of the run that recorded this part. A part kept from an earlier run keeps its own, so one entry's parts can name folders the entry's evidence and evidence_history do not; the export copies every folder an entry or any of its parts names. A part without it, written before parts named their folder, was recorded in the entry's evidence folder or one its evidence_history lists.
